title: Plans: when to upgrade
description: Do you need Growth? Stay on Free until you hit a limit or want live chat. Listing and selling work on Free—upgrade is capacity and support, not permission to sell.
content:
Do you need Growth? Stay on Free until you hit a limit (or want live chat). You can list on Explore and sell with Stripe on Free. Upgrade means capacity and support—not permission to sell.

Primary action: See pricing · upgrade in /billing.

Short answer

Free is enough for many creators. Growth unlocks higher hub/upload/file limits and live chat. The marketplace take rate stays 5% on Free and Growth.

When Free is enough

  • ≤3 hubs
  • ≤10 counted uploads per hub
  • Files within about 5 MB
  • Monetizing with Stripe Connect
  • Unlimited collaborators
  • Listing on Explore

Upgrade triggers

You’re trying to…Free blocks you?Growth
Create a 4th hubYesUnlimited hubs
Add an 11th counted upload in a hubYesUnlimited uploads
Upload a large file (>~5 MB)YesMuch larger files (marketed up to 5 GB)
Get live chat support—Included
Sell hubs / keep 5% take rateAlready allowedSame 5%

Price snapshot

  • Growth: $9.99/mo or $99.99/yr
  • Full table + Enterprise → Pricing (or /pricing#when-to-upgrade)

Fees stay the same. Aura Library’s 5% marketplace fee applies on Free and Growth. Growth does not remove it. Stripe processing fees are separate. Selling walkthrough: Turn on paid access.

How to upgrade

  1. In-app: open /billing, or follow the prompt when you hit a limit.
  2. Complete checkout.
  3. Confirm your plan after purchase.

Myths

  • “I need Growth to monetize” → False
  • “Growth removes the 5% fee” → False
  • “Free can’t list on Explore” → False

Quick facts

  • Free: 3 hubs · ~10 uploads/hub · ~5 MB files
  • Growth price: $9.99/mo or $99.99/yr
  • Take rate: 5% Free and Growth
  • Plan roles (product): free · paid (Growth) · enterprise
